title: Melody
short: Robert Schumann · C 4/4 · listen, then play it.
trouble: Reading notes one at a time instead of in chunks.

blocks.html: The first piece in the album Schumann wrote in 1848 for his three daughters. The right hand sings a slow tune while the left hand flows in eighth notes. Both hands read the treble clef here. Play softly, and let each phrase rise and fall like a sung line.
What to notice: Album for the Young, Op. 68, No. 1 (1848)

blocks.name: music-player
blocks.cap: Play it: the score scrolls, the keys light up, and “wait for me” lets you practise one hand at a time.

items: a singing tune over flowing eighth notes

blocks.html: Play through it once with the right hand only, then add the left. Which chord change made you stop?

sources.name: Mutopia Project edition (Philippe Hézaine, from the Peters edition; the music is public domain, the typesetting is CC BY-SA 2.5), compared with this file note by note by our checking script. Fingering and dynamics from that edition. Date from Wikipedia.
